definition: Unmodified source descriptor retained for provenance and rollback.
decision_rule: Always preserve when source field is populated.

definition: Plant or animal anatomical structure from which feed material derives.
decision_rule: Use only when descriptor identifies biological anatomy rather than processed product.

definition: Physical presentation or form of feed material.
decision_rule: Use for form independent of biological part and economic role.

definition: Transformation applied to produce or prepare feed material.
decision_rule: Use for an operation; do not use for resulting material identity alone.

definition: Economic or production role such as primary product by-product or waste.
decision_rule: Use for contextual role; role does not assert material identity.

definition: Chemical substance or fraction present in or isolated from feed material.
decision_rule: Use only for constituent identity; measured composition remains SOSA/QUDT observation.

definition: Descriptor expressing two or more facets or a derived material requiring decomposition.
decision_rule: Split into reviewed assertions; never mint one opaque mapping automatically.

definition: Meaning or facet cannot be established from available evidence.
decision_rule: Hold without IRI and retain raw descriptor for later review.
